title: Build and enforce machine-checkable S1 canonical evidence admission
blocker: Canonical dataset artifact admission is not proven even though crawler/contracts/runtime exist
immediate_action: Implement a credential-free verifier for the S1 canonical evidence manifest and connect it to the Brain admission semantics without fabricating data
exit_criteria: Verifier can distinguish contract/scaffold existence from a real admitted canonical artifact; S1 remains DENY/UNKNOWN until every required evidence item is independently verifiable
downstream_impact: S2_VALID_RESEARCH remains UNKNOWN/LOCKED; S3-S7 remain UNREACHED/LOCKED
peer_required_action: xsmb-quant must provide a real evidence package or authoritative external sink with an exact observable receipt; Quant_Engine must not consume unadmitted data as canonical truth
safe_parallel_work: QUANT-N010 computation/workflow hardening may continue locally as prerequisite engineering only; it cannot unlock Brain gates or promote E2E state
forensic_rule: LIVE runtime != valid data; valid data != admitted canonical data; admitted canonical data != valid research. Each transition owns its evidence.
successor_instruction: Read docs/architecture/FORENSIC_ADMISSION_CHAIN.md and contracts/s1_canonical_evidence_manifest.schema.json before modifying admission logic. Preserve old DENY/UNKNOWN events; corrections create new version/hash/admission event.
